translations.web: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
translations.bsb: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
translations.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
translations.asv: If his master give him a wife and she bear him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
